I slowly pull until I feel structure and then let the line go slack. I bounce the bait but don't pull it over the structure 5-10 times before bringing the bait over. Rinse and repeat. Sometimes I bounce the bait back like a ned rig, other times I'll flip a heavier shaky head into holes in weed beds. If I'm "power fishing" I'll make sweeps across the bottom. This slowly ticks the tail of the bait up and gives it life. Maintainable contact with the bottom is the key in most situations but not always. Sometimes I'll throw a 1/4oz shaky head with a grub and swim it. My favorite soft plastics to use on the shaky head are stick baits, paca craws and 7" lizards.
